# Vendored libraries

Served locally, without a CDN and without a build step: the Content-Security-Policy only allows the website's own files. Files are unchanged from their official releases.

| Library | Version | Licence | Files | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| jQuery | 3.6.4 | MIT | `jquery/jquery.min.js` | official release (npm) |
| DataTables | 1.13.8 | MIT | `datatables/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js` (the table look is in `css/admin.css`) | official release (npm) |
| Font Awesome Free | 7.2.0 | icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT (`fontawesome/LICENSE.txt`) | `fontawesome/css/all.min.css`, `fontawesome/webfonts/*.woff2` (solid, regular, brands, v4 compatibility) | official release |

Updating: download the distribution files from the official release (npm package or GitHub release), check them against the release, replace the files unchanged and update this table.
